title: Which brand will be Kylian Mbappe’s principal personal sportswear sponsor on September 18, 2026?
background: Kylian Mbappe is a Real Madrid forward with a longstanding individual sponsorship agreement with Nike.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official sponsorship announcements by Mbappe or the sponsoring brand, supported by reliable contemporaneous news reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the brand holding Mbappe’s principal individual sportswear sponsorship as of September 18, 2026. If no sponsorship change has been announced by that date, resolve to his incumbent sponsor. Club kit suppliers and endorsements outside sportswear do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the sportswear brand.
